product.name: Monoprice 8-Outlet Rotating Surge Protector Power Strip - 2160 Joules Clamping Voltage 330V L‑N 400V L‑G 400V N‑G 6ft Cord
product.description: Monoprice™8-Outlet Rotating Surge Protector2160 Joules to protect from damaging voltage and current spikesThe Monoprice™ 8‑Outlet Rotating Surge Protector features eight protected outlets, six of which can rotate 180° for use with bulky power adapters, without blocking adjacent outlets. It is rated for 125 VAC, 15 amps/1800 watts and provides up to 2160 Joules of power protection, with the ability to handle current spikes up to 144,000 amps. One LED indicates that the surge protector is plugged into an outlet with a valid ground connection, while a second LED indicates that surge protection is active. When the latter LED turns off, the protection circuitry has been consumed and the protector should be replaced. An auto shutoff feature turns the protector off when the protection has been consumed to prevent damage to your equipment. The switch doubles as a circuit breaker and has a six foot power cord with a straight connector.Eight protected outletsSix outlets rotate 180° for use with power adapters2160 Joules of surge protection48dB EMI/RFI filtrationUL® listed400V L‑G/N‑G and 330V L‑N clamping voltagesProtection and ground LED indicatorsAuto shutoff feature cuts off power once surge protection has been consumedSix foot power cord with straight plug DESIGNED FOR POWER ADAPTERSUnlike ordinary surge protector power strips, this surge protector features six outlets that can rotate 180° for use with AC power adapters, ensuring that all outlets are usable, regardless of what is plugged into them.PROTECT AGAINST TRANSIENT SPIKESThis surge protector features 2160 Joules of surge protection and can handle current spikes up to 144,000 amps. It has 400 volts Line‑Ground, 400 volts Neutral‑Ground, and 330 volts Line‑Neutral clamping voltages, which are the voltage spike levels that will cause the protection circuitry to activate. These are the two lowest voltages specified by Underwriters Laboratories® for surge protectors, which provides the greatest amount of protection for your equipment.KNOW YOUR EQUIPMENT IS PROTECTEDThe PROTECTED LED illuminates to indicate that surge protection is available. When it turns off, the protection has been consumed and the protector should be replaced. Additionally, an automatic shutoff feature turns the protector off when the protection has been consumed, ensuring that your equipment does not get unprotected power.PROTECT ALL YOUR EQUIPMENTThis surge protector can protect all your equipment from short circuits, overloading, and excessive current draw. The circuit breaker in the power switch trips when the current draw exceeds 15 amps, ensuring that your equipment is always protected.EMI/RFI FILTRATIONThis surge protector features 48dB of EMI/RFI filtration, protecting your equipment from line noise and outside interference.
